metadata.case_name: YEUNG WAI KIT v. POON PAK HO

injuries.description: fractured right orbital floor, ethmoid anterior, medial and lateral walls of right maxillary sinuses and right zygoma
injuries.body_part: right orbit / right zygoma / right maxillary sinuses
source: CT scan of orbit showed fractured right orbital floor, ethmoid anterior, medial and lateral walls of right maxillary sinuses and right zygoma.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of skull due to birth injury

injuries.description: right eye subconjunctival hemorrhage and right periorbital swelling
source: He was diagnosed to suffer from right eye subconjunctival hemorrhage, right periorbital swelling and right infraorbital numbness.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of conjunctiva or corneal abrasion without mention of foreign body

source: After suturing of his lip laceration on 2 Apr 2013, the Plaintiff was discharged from PWH on 3 Apr 2013.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: fracture of proximal phalanx of left ring and left little fingers
source: deformed left hand and left ring finger and left little finger (X-ray of left hand showed fracture of proximal phalanx of left ring and left little fingers)
the plaintiff broke one upper molar in the accident and was advised to seek restoration in private sector, which he did by consulting Dr Wong Hiu Ching of Healthy Smile in July 2013.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of hard dental tissues and pulp, unspecified

manifestations.description: bruise on forehead and below right eye
mild residual finger stiffness and gripping weakness of left ring and little fingers
some mild reduction in power for left injured fingers
scar on upper left lip of about 1cm (unnoticeable at close distance)
4cm and 3cm long scars on the back of his left ring and little fingers (noticeable, lighter in color)
nightmares, poor sleep and avoidance behaviors (post-traumatic stress reactions)

treatments_received.treatment: suturing of his lip laceration on 2 Apr 2013
source: After suturing of his lip laceration on 2 Apr 2013, the Plaintiff was discharged from PWH on 3 Apr 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: open reduction of maxillary fracture on 11 Apr 2013
source: open reduction of maxillary fracture) on 11 Apr 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: Open reduction and internal fixation of his left 2 finger fractures on 16 Apr 2013
source: Open reduction and internal fixation of his left 2 finger fractures were done on 16 Apr 2013 after dental surgery (open reduction of maxillary fracture) on 11 Apr 2013.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for clavicle / hand / foot (except carpal / talus / calcaneus) +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: splintage provided by Occupational Therapy Department; splints advised to stop in Jun 2013
source: The Plaintiff was referred to the Occupational Therapy Department of PWH for splintage for protecting fracture site after operation on 16 Apr 2013 and splints were provided during in-patient phase. All splints were advised to stop in Jun 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy in form of ice therapy, electrotherapy, mobilization and strengthening exercise (30 Apr 2013 to 9 Aug 2013)
source: He was also referred to the Department for Physiotherapy of PWH from 30 Apr 2013 to 9 Aug 2013. Physiotherapy in form of ice therapy, electrotherapy, mobilization and strengthening exercise was given to him.

treatments_received.treatment: referral to Li Ka Shing Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic for post-traumatic stress reactions (appointment scheduled Sept 2013 but defaulted)
source: On 18 Jun 2013, the Plaintiff was once referred to Li Ka Shing Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic for his post-traumatic stress reactions after the accident.

treatments_received.treatment: private dental restoration consultation with Dr Wong Hiu Ching of Healthy Smile in July 2013
source: the plaintiff broke one upper molar in the accident and was advised to seek restoration in private sector, which he did by consulting Dr Wong Hiu Ching of Healthy Smile in July 2013.

losses.description: Residual stiffness, gripping weakness and mild reduction in power of left ring and little fingers affecting lifting heavy objects
Scars on the back of left ring and little fingers (4cm and 3cm) and a scar on upper left lip
Post-traumatic stress reactions including nightmares, poor sleep and avoidance behaviours
